visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long, wavy dark hair and a grey t-shirt stands in a kitchen setting with white walls and a blue cabinet, gesturing excitedly towards the camera with both hands. Large yellow stylized text overlays appear above him and across the screen. (2) A close-up shot shows hands holding a plastic pudding cup and flipping it onto a black plate; a yellow and dark-brown pudding slides out perfectly. (3) The scene shifts to hands submerging rectangular gelatin sheets into a bowl of clear water on a wooden countertop. (4) In a white pot, liquid milk and cream are combined with white sugar and condensed milk; the man holds up a bottle of Red Diamond Vanilla extract to show the label. (5) A pink spatula stirs the white liquid in the pot over a portable stove; the mixture is then strained through a fine mesh sieve into a bowl, and orange food coloring is added using a toothpick. (6) The man stirs the yellow liquid as it thickens, then pours it into a flower-shaped plastic mold. (7) Using scissors, the man cuts more gelatin sheets and soaks them in water. (8) Brown sugar and water are boiled in the white pot until bubbling and dark; gelatin is then stirred into the syrup. (9) The man carefully pours the dark brown syrup over the already set yellow pudding layer inside the plastic mold. (10) The man places a white plate over the mold, flips it, and shakes it vigorously before lifting the mold to reveal a large, two-layered flower-shaped pudding. He raises his hands in a 'surprised' gesture. (11) A series of shots shows the man eating a spoonful of the pudding with a satisfied expression. (12) A second man in a grey tank top and baseball cap tastes the pudding and smiles. (13) A young woman with braces holds the plate, laughing as the large pudding wobbles and a piece slides off.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-energy male narration (Voice A) over a fast-tempo synth-pop BGM. Distinct 'pop' and 'ding' cartoon SFX sync with the appearance of text. (2) A wet, percussive thud occurs as a pudding slides onto a plate. An off-screen female voice (Voice B) asks a short question, followed immediately by Voice A's energetic response. (3) Continuous sounds of liquid pouring, metal whisking, and glass clinking against wood accompany the cooking process. The BGM maintains a steady, driving beat. (4) A sharp metallic 'snip' sound occurs as scissors cut gelatin, followed by the soft splash of water. (5) Rhythmic bubbling sounds indicate liquid boiling, followed by a sustained pouring sound with a medium frequency bandwidth. (6) A rapid percussive rattling sound signifies the shaking of the plate, culminating in a series of high-pitched 'Wow' screams from Voice A. (7) Clear metallic clinking of a spoon against a ceramic plate is followed by slurping and chewing sounds. Voice A speaks with a slightly muffled quality (eating) in a very positive tone. (8) A new, calmer male voice (Voice C) provides a brief review with lower vocal arousal. (9) Laughter from Voice A and a female voice (Voice D) is followed by a sudden 'splat' sound and a comedic scream from Voice D.
